title: Businessman shot in the face after suspects snatch his gold necklace in Batangas
summary: A 78-year-old businessman was shot in the face moments after motorcycle-riding suspects snatched his gold necklace in Barangay Sinipian, Sta. Teresita, Batangas on Tuesday afternoon.
